parsing: Same pre-existing complete-initial-choice JSON decoder as the independent resource confirmation; optional code fences and trailing explanatory prose accepted. Invalid/incomplete initial choice is terminal, not replaced.
acquisition: 32 blocks each containing459 distinct prompts in shuffled order. First16 blocks estimate probabilities with Dirichlet0.5 smoothing over four outcomes; conditional three-choice probabilities also retained. Predictions are saved and hashed before any second-half dispatch. Second16 blocks validate the fixed probabilities. All32 then estimate the collective transition kernel. Reuse of old responses excluded to keep one acquisition series.
collective: Exact171-count-state kernel conditional on a memoryless, stable policy and independent service draws, one uniformly sampled agent per update. Empirical MLE and Dirichlet0.5 posterior-mean tables. Native versus average over6 input/output label permutations. Post-update early1..170 and late681..1020 cost=sum(loads^2)/97. These windows are descriptive calibration diagnostics, not a frozen future collective-test primary.
stopping: Reviewed compatible-model format failures are terminal missing outcomes and do not stop remaining scheduled inputs; no replacement sampling.
format_failure_amendment: After1138 real replies including one truncated prose response and before any half-prediction freeze: retain malformed/truncated choices as terminal fourth outcomes, never replace. Validate four-class probabilities (Dirichlet0.5 over A/B/C/failure); estimate three-choice collective tables conditional on valid outputs. Report observed missing counts and empirical-mass worst-case finite-horizon sensitivity separately. Same prompts, schedule,14688 total responses,64 output tokens,8 workers. No policy fallback is claimed as observed behavior.
